impl: benchmark/dct8x8 (portable alpaka; one work item per full 8x8 block, separable orthonormal DCT-II / inverse DCT-III)
note_gpu_assignment: protocol requested rosi_v100 (Tesla V100), CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3; rosi_v100 was unreachable via compute MCP for the whole run. Used connected fwk394 (Quadro GV100, sm_70, CUDA 12.5) with GPU index 1.

reference.algorithm: NVIDIA CUDA SDK dct8x8 sample; AAN 8-point fast DCT (H.264-style separable 8x8 transform). NVIDIA SDK EULA header; HeCBench repo is MIT (ORNL). Reference not vendored.
reference.omp_note: omp target teams offload program for icpx; built with g++ -fopenmp the offload pragmas are ignored and the teams loop runs on the host, so it is a functional CPU check only

timing_scope: per-transform end-to-end on the queue: one sample runs repeat transforms, reported value is total/repeat; median of samples after one warm-up
acceptance_metric: GPU (CUDA) runtime ratio, median alpaka / median reference

metrics.note: no tuned CPU reference (g++ -fopenmp omp reference does not offload); correctness against the double-precision host oracle

performance_exception.summary: The GPU kernel is slower than the pinned CUDA reference (ratio > 1.10): ~1.5x at 8192x8192 and ~2.6-2.9x at 999x777. The reference is the hand-tuned NVIDIA CUDA SDK kernel: one thread per 8x8 block, shared-memory transpose so both passes are coalesced, 32 registers and 512-thread blocks giving high occupancy.
performance_exception.port_cost: The portable register tile costs 216 registers per thread, which caps occupancy.
performance_exception.outcome: None matched the reference on the 8192x8192 workload; the transform, scaling, block layout and comparison stay exact.

validation.kind: relative L2 < 1e-6 against an independent double-precision host oracle, plus explicit NaN/Inf rejection
validation.rationale: the reference's own acceptance is relative L2 < 1e-6. The float fast transform versus the double oracle measures 8.2e-8 (8x8) .. 8.8e-8 (8192x8192) forward and 1.3e-7 inverse; the GPU kernel reaches 7.9e-8..9.5e-8, three orders of magnitude below the threshold. The tolerance is not widened.

repro.cuda_build: PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda cmake --preset rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=70 -Dalpaka_COMPILE_PEDANTIC=ON . && cmake --build build/rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc --target dct8x8_alpaka -j
repro.ref_cuda: nvcc -std=c++17 -Xcompiler -Wall -arch=sm_70 -O3 main.cu kernels.cu DCT8x8_gold.cu -o dct8x8_cuda_ref && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 ./dct8x8_cuda_ref 8192 8192 100
